translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Winjuru, Ruoth nobed gi loch makare
kendo jotelo nobed gi telo mar adier.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato nobed kar gengʼruok
ne kalausi mana ka aore mamol e piny ongoro,
kendo mana ka tipo mar Lwanda maduongʼ e piny motwo.
Eka wenge joma neno ok nochak ogengʼ,
kendo joma ochiko itgi nowinj wach.
Chuny ngʼat mamuomore nowinj wach gi tiende
kendo ngʼat ma radwal nowuo maber kendo maliw.
Ok nochak oluong ngʼat mofuwo ni ngʼat malongʼo,
kata ngʼat ma ja-miganga ni ngʼat ma ogen.
Nimar ngʼat mofuwo wacho weche mofuwo,
kendo opongʼ gi richo:
Otimo timbe mag richo
kendo olando miriambo kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
mi omon joma odenyo chamo gik monego gicham
kendo joma riyo oloyo otamoe pi.
Ngʼat ma achach yorene richo,
osiko ka chunye chano mana timo richo,
kotieko jodhier gi miriambo kata obedo ni
ywak mar joma ni e chandruok nikare.
To ngʼat mogen loso weche mabeyo
kendo kuom timbe makare miyo ochungʼ motegno.
Un mon maparo ni odak e ngima maber,
auru malo kendo uwinj wachna,
un nyiri modak gi kwe,
winjuru gima awacho!
Bangʼ higa achiel,
un ma uparo nudak mokwe, kibaji nogou;
cham ok nochiegi,
kendo keyo mar mzabibu ok nobedie.
Beduru moluor un mon maparo nodak e ngima maber;
beduru mokuyo, un nyiri maparo nodak gi kwe!
Lonyreuru duge kendo utwe piende gugru enungou.
Ywaguru ka ugoyo agogu nikech puothe momewo,
nikech olembe mag mzabibu,
kendo kuom piny joga,
piny mopongʼ gi kuthe kod pedo,
ee, ywaguru udi ma yande mor opongʼo
kendo kuom dala maduongʼ mar mor gi ilo masani odongʼ nono.
Kama ochiel motegno nojwangʼ,
dala maduongʼ nodongʼ gunda;
kama ochiel motegno mag siro lweny kod kar ngʼicho
nodongʼ kama punda bukore, kod kar kwadh jamni,
nyaka chop Roho ol kuomwa koa malo,
kendo piny motwo nolokre kuonde mamiyo,
mi kuonde mamiyo nonenre ka bungu.
Adiera nobedie e piny motwo,
mi tim makare nodag e puodho mamiyo.
Olemb tim makare nobed kwe;
to tim makare nokel horuok gi chir nyaka chiengʼ.
Joga nodag kuonde ma kwe nitie,
e mier moger motegno,
kendo kuonde ma kwe nitie ma koko ongee.
Kata obedo ni pe nolwer bunge
kendo dala maduongʼ nopodh chuth,
to mano kaka inibed ngʼama ogwedhi,
ka ichwoyo chambi e bath aore duto,
kendo ka iweyo jambi kod punde magi wuotho awuotha kaka ohero.
